newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOTOR RACING-BRIDGESTONE TO SUPPLY TYRES TO TWR ARROWS IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BRIDGESTONE TO SUPPLY TYRES TO TWR ARROWS IN 1997.

text.p: Japanese manufacturer Bridgestone confirmed on Wednesday it would supply tyres to the TWR Arrows formula one team for the 1997 world championship.
Britain's Damon Hill, on the verge of clinching the world title in a Williams-Renault in Sunday's Japanese grand prix, has signed for TWR Arrows next season.
The British-based Arrows team, currently ninth in the constructors' world championship, was acquired by the Tom Walkinshaw Racing group earlier this year.

Bridgestone is entering formula one 12 months ahead of schedule after stepping up tyre development this year in test sessions at various circuits, including Suzuka in Japan and Silverstone in Britain.
A spokesman said the company was also negotiating to supply tyres to two or three other formula one teams in 1997.
At present all formula one tyres are provided by Goodyear.
